# int64 and uint64 multiplication is not rewritten: simd.Int64s/Uint64s have no Mul method.

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
! stderr .
! exists ops_simd.go
cmp ops.go ops.go.orig

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func MulInt64s(dst, src []int64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] *= src[i]
	}
}

func MulUint64s(dst, src []uint64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] *= src[i]
	}
}
